nav.stalledWarning: The build has been silent for over 90 seconds — it looks stuck. Click “Cancel” to kill the process and try again.

history.title: Version history
history.subtitle: Document change log
history.empty: History is empty. An entry will appear after the first build or a manual note.

compile.explainTitle: Explain the error in plain words (no edits)
compile.fixWithAiTitle: Open the agent and fix the build
compile.stalledWarning: The build has been silent for over 90 seconds. Docker is most likely stuck on a network operation or a heavy page. Click “Cancel” to kill the process — the backend will clean up the record and unlock the buttons.
compile.fixPrompt: The build of document [{{code}}](doc:{{docId}}) finished with errors. Study the log of the last build (`{{logPath}}`) and the source `{{file}}`, find the cause of the LaTeX errors and fix them. After the edits, rebuild the document with the compile_document tool and make sure the build passes without errors.
compile.explainPrompt: The build of document [{{code}}](doc:{{docId}}) failed. Read the log of the last build (`{{logPath}}`) and explain in plain language what causes the LaTeX error and how to fix it. Do NOT change files — just explain.

wait.queuedBody: The build starts as soon as a runner is free. You can leave this page: the result will appear in the document.
wait.quotaBody: You already have the maximum number of builds running. This one starts by itself when one of them finishes.
wait.noRunnerBody: No online runner can build this document right now. The build starts by itself once a runner appears; if none shows up for several minutes, the server removes the build from the queue and names the reason.
wait.runnerPaused: Waiting for a runner: it is paused
wait.runnerPausedBody: Only a runner that is paused right now can build this document. Resume it (a personal runner: “Settings → My runners”, a shared one: the administrator) and the build will run. If it stays paused for 30 minutes, the server removes the build from the queue.
wait.runnerLostBody: The runner building this document went away. The build was handed to another runner, no action needed.
wait.personalRunnerBody: The build goes to a personal runner. If it doesn't take it within a few seconds, it goes to the installation's shared runners.
wait.superseded: Build replaced by a newer one
wait.supersededBody: While this build was waiting, a newer build of the same document was queued and took its place. See the result in the newer build.

placement.waitingMe: Waiting for your runner "{{name}}"… (up to {{seconds}} s)
placement.waitingMeNoName: Waiting for your runner… (up to {{seconds}} s)

fallbackMe.offline: Your runner is offline, built on a shared runner
fallbackMe.busy: Your runner is busy, built on a shared runner
fallbackMe.timeout: Your runner didn't pick the build within {{seconds}} s, built on a shared runner
fallbackMe.lost: Your runner dropped mid-build, retried on a shared runner
fallbackMe.disabled: Personal runners are off, built on a shared runner

fallbackOwner.offline: The owner's runner is offline, built on a shared runner
fallbackOwner.busy: The owner's runner is busy, built on a shared runner
fallbackOwner.timeout: The owner's runner didn't pick the build within {{seconds}} s, built on a shared runner
fallbackOwner.lost: The owner's runner dropped mid-build, retried on a shared runner
fallbackOwner.disabled: Personal runners are off, built on a shared runner

unavailable.title: Cloud build is unavailable right now
unavailable.noRunners: No runner is connected to the server.
unavailable.local: Build the document locally in the desktop Studio: sync the project, build it there, and the PDF will show up on the server.
unavailable.admin: Or ask the administrator to connect a runner.
unavailable.adminSelf: Connect a runner in the admin area.
unavailable.buildAllExcluded: Not queued ({{count}}): {{list}}. The other documents are building.

cause.personal_paused: The personal runner for {{kinds}} is paused: resume it in “Settings → My runners” and the build will run.
cause.shared_paused: The shared runner for {{kinds}} is paused.
cause.personal_offline: The personal runner for {{kinds}} is offline: start the desktop Studio.
cause.shared_offline: The shared runner for {{kinds}} is offline.

failure.title: Build failed
failure.unknownReason: The reason was not recorded: the build ran on a version without this diagnostics. Open the log below; if it is empty, build the document again.
failure.noOutputNotStarted: There is no build output: LaTeX was not started, the build stopped earlier. The reason is above.
failure.noOutputEmpty: There is no build output: the runner did not send a single log line. The reason is above; if there is none, it is a runner failure, check its log on its machine.

compile.placesMoved: Template signature places moved to the new layout: {{n}}

preview.askAgentPrompt:
Explain and check this excerpt from “{{name}}”:

“{{text}}”
preview.syncTexUnavailable: SyncTeX unavailable — rebuild the document to enable jumping to the source
preview.notBuiltHint: The document has not been compiled yet. Click “Build”
preview.notBuiltEngineHint: — latexmk will run {{engine}} up to {{passes}} {{passWord}} (until references and the table of contents converge).
preview.notBuiltCopyHint: The document has not been built yet. Click “Build” — the build just runs the checks and publishes the file (no compilation).
preview.nonPdfHint: Preview is not available for this format — download the file or open it in an external application.
preview.customNoPreviewHint: This is a custom document — preview is not available for this format. Download the file or open it as text.
preview.officeConvertHint: The PDF preview will appear after installing the converter — Settings → Presentations
preview.htmlPreviewTooltip: Live render of the HTML presentation (slides are interactive right here). The RevealJS template loads its library from a CDN — offline it renders unstyled. The HTML file itself is what you submit.
preview.convertedTooltip: Auto-converted from {{ext}} (LibreOffice). Layout may differ slightly — the {{ext}} itself is what you submit.
preview.wordCountTooltip: Words · characters of the document text (excluding commands, comments and the table of contents; imports included) — texcount
preview.downloadFinalTitle: Download the final PDF: the frozen file, with embedded PAdES signatures if there are any
preview.downloadSignedTitle: Download a PDF for printing: signature images and plates, no electronic signatures (sources on disk are unchanged)

source.binaryHint: Binary source — edit it in PowerPoint or another external editor.

office.startingHint: The first launch can take a minute or two.
office.autosaveNote: Edits are saved automatically into the project's document file. The PDF preview refreshes on its own a few seconds after a save.
office.notInstalledBody: The built-in Word/Excel/PowerPoint editor runs on ONLYOFFICE Document Server. It is a separate Docker image (~4 GB) you install once — after that the editor starts automatically.
office.scriptError: Failed to load the editor script (api.js). Make sure the ONLYOFFICE container is running and try again.

busy.title: The editor is busy right now
busy.body: All seats in the document editor are taken (up to {{limit}} people can edit at once). Wait a moment and try again.
busy.downloadHint: You can download the file, edit it in your own app and upload it back from the document menu.

checks.fixWithAiTitle: Open the agent and review the remarks
checks.rulesSubtitle: Manage the set of checks for this document.
checks.customFileBanner: This is a custom document. Some GOST/ESPD checks were skipped — they rely on the LaTeX structure of the template.

card.ignoreRuleInDocument: Ignore the rule in the document

signatures.customUnsignableHint: Signing is not available — this custom document isn't a PDF and can't be converted automatically. You are responsible for signing it yourself.
signatures.customConvertiblePendingPreview: The exact signature position can be set once a PDF preview is available.
signatures.customDrawnSignatureHint: Studio doesn't see a signature inside the uploaded PDF: upload the signature as an image into the slot.

customFile.uploadModalDescription: Replaces the template-generated document “{{name}}” with your own file. Word, PowerPoint, PDF — anything works.
customFile.dropTitle: Drag a file here or click to choose one
customFile.classConvertible: Looks like a Word/PowerPoint document — we can offer to convert it to PDF when packaging.
customFile.classPdf: PDF — preview and signing will work as usual. Studio doesn't see a signature inside the uploaded PDF: upload the signature as an image into the slot.
customFile.classUnknown: Format not recognized — the file will be included in the package as-is, with no conversion. You'll need to sign it yourself.
customFile.uploadedToast: File “{{name}}” uploaded in place of the template document
customFile.revertConfirmTitle: Revert the document to the template?
customFile.revertConfirmDescription: The uploaded file will stop being used. The file itself stays on disk — you can switch back to it later.
customFile.revertedToast: Document reverted to the template version
